# Sundae

> Sundae is a decision intelligence platform for closed-loop profit recovery in multi-location food-service operations.

Sundae helps operators recover preventable profit loss across every location. It finds where profit is slipping, helps the right person act, and measures what changed. Its operating loop is: detect, decide, execute, measure, learn.

Sundae does not claim to remove macroeconomic pressures such as wage increases, taxes, rates, or commodity inflation. It helps teams distinguish controllable operational losses, route accountable action, and measure whether margin was protected or recovered.
